title: Changing scene from script causes weird behavior
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in: 4.5dev1, 4.4.1, 4.4

### System information

Godot v4.5.dev1 - Arch Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Thu, 13 Mar 2025 18:12:00 +0000 on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 (nvidia; 570.133.07) - AMD Ryzen 5 3600 6-Core Processor (12 threads)

### Issue description

In my game the main menu scene would work fine when started by the engine as the main scene, however after using this script to change it
```gdscript
extends Node

const MAIN_MENU = preload("uid://cys7pghyx6n2d")

@onready var tree := get_tree()

func load_main_menu() -> void:
	tree.change_scene_to_packed(MAIN_MENU)
```

the start button wouldn't active the function connected to the signal.
```gdscript
func _ready() -> void:
	print(get_signal_connection(&"pressed"))
```
however, this script in the button would still print that the signal is connected.

I tried creating a MRP, but got different results, the scene wouldn't load if i loaded it using preload() and SceneTree.change_scene_to_packed and would return the error
```
E 0:00:03:740   test_scene.gd:6 @ _on_broken_button_pressed(): Failed to instantiate scene state of "", node count is 0. Make sure the PackedScene resource is valid.
  <C++ Error>   Condition "nc == 0" is true. Returning: nullptr
  <C++ Source>  scene/resources/packed_scene.cpp:141 @ instantiate()
  <Stack Trace> test_scene.gd:6 @ _on_broken_button_pressed()
E 0:00:03:740   test_scene.gd:6 @ _on_broken_button_pressed(): Parameter "new_scene" is null.
  <C++ Source>  scene/main/scene_tree.cpp:1554 @ change_scene_to_packed()
  <Stack Trace> test_scene.gd:6 @ _on_broken_button_pressed()
```
However it would work without issue if I load it using SceneTree.change_scene_to_file or SceneTree.change_scene_to_packed(load()).
using SceneTree.change_scene_to_file didn't change anything in my game.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Download the MRP
2. Open it in Godot 4.5dev1
3. Press the buttons

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[MRP.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/19522484/MRP.zip)
